spans.s: 1. युव॑ actual base of the 2nd pers. pron. in the dual number (from which the forms युवा॑म्, युवा॑भ्याम्, युव॑योस्; Ved. also युव॑म्, युव॑भ्याम्, युव॑त्, युवो॑स्, are derived).
2. युव in comp. for युवन्.
1. युवा (for 2. See col. 3), in comp. for 1. युव.
2. युवा f. (for 1. See col. 2) N. of one of Agni's arrows, TS.
युव—द्रि॑क् ind. directed towards both of you, RV.
युव॑—धित (युव॑-), mfn. placed or arranged by you both, ib.
युवद्-देवत्य᳙ mfn. having (both of) you for a divinity, ŚBr.
or युवायु॑, mfn. longing for you both, RV.
or युवायु॑, mfn. longing for you both, RV.
युवा॑—दत्त (युवा॑-), mfn. given to both of you, RV.
युवा॑—नीत (युवा॑-), mfn. brought by both of you, ib.
युवा—यु॑ज् mfn. yoked or harnessed by (or for) both of you, ib.
युवा॑—वत् (युवा॑-), mfn. belonging to both of you, ib.
(sometimes ind., with gen. or dat.) belonging or devoted to both of you, RV.
युवा-दत्त &c. See col. 2.
See col. 3.
a youth, young man, Śāktān.
mf(यूनी, or युवती or युवति, q.v.)n. (prob. fr. √ 2. यु) young, youthful, adult (applied to men and animals), strong, good, healthy, RV. &c. &c.
a youth, young man, young animal (in Veda often applied to gods, esp. to Indra, Agni, and the Maruts), ib.
(in gram.) the younger descendant of any one (an elder being still alive), Pāṇ. i, 2, 65, &c.
N. of the ninth year in Jupiter's cycle of 60 years, Jyot.; an elephant 60 years old, Gal.

etym.s: [cf. Lat. juvenis, juventa; Slav. junǔ; Lith. jáunas; Goth. juggs ; Germ. junc, jung; Angl.Sax. geong; Eng. young.]

spans.s: युव—खलति mfn. bald in youth
युव—खलती f. bald in girlhood, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 67, Sch.
युव—गण्ड m. an eruption on the face of young people, L.
युव—जरत् mf(अती)n. appearing old in youth, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 67, Sch.
यु॑व—जानि (यु॑व-), mfn. having a young wife, RV. viii, 2, 19.
युव—ता f. (Subh.) youthfulness, youth.
युव—त्व n. (Sāy.) youthfulness, youth.
युव—पलित mf(आ)n. grey-haired in youth, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 67, Sch.
युव—प्रत्यय m. a suffix forming the so-called Yuvan patronymics, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 59 &c. Sch.
युव—मारिन् mf(इणी)n. dying in youth, Āpast. (cf. अ-युवम्˚).
युव—राज m. ‘young king’, an heir-apparent associated with the reigning sovereign in the government, crown prince, R.; VarBṛS. &c.
N. of Maitreya (the future Buddha), L.
of various authors, Cat.
युव—राज—त्व n. the rank or position of an heir-apparent to a throne, R.; Kathās.; Rājat.
युव—राज—दिवाकर m. N. of a poet, Cat.
युव—राजन् m. = -राज, Hariv.
युव—राज्य n. = -राज-त्व, Kathās.; Pañcat.
युव—वलिन mf(आ)n. having wrinkles in youth, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 67, Sch.
युव—सेन m. N. of a poet, Cat.
युव—हन् mf(घ्नी)n. child-murdering, infanticide, Car.
young, RV.; Suparṇ.

a girl, young woman, any young female animal, RV. &c. &c. (in RV. applied to Uṣas, Night and Morning, Heaven and Earth &c.; with शर्या, prob. ‘an arrow just shot off’; but cf. युवा॑; ifc. as f. for युवन्, a youth, e.g. स-बाल-वृद्धयुवतिः पुरी, a town with boys, old and young men, Hariv.)
turmeric, L.
= युवति, a girl, young woman, MBh.; R. &c.
(in astron.) the zodiacal sign Virgo.
युवति—जन m. a young woman, Bhartṛ.
युवती—जन m. = युवति-ज्˚, MBh.
युवति—दा f. bestowing young women, ĀpŚr.
yellow jasmine, L.
युवती—सम्भोग-कार m. N. of a poet, Cat.
युवती—सार्थ m. a multitude of young women, Ratnāv. (in Prākṛt ˚thaka).
youthful, juvenile, RV.
युव-पलित &c. See above.
young, youthful, juvenile
a youth, RV.
young, Hcat.
become young, Kathās.
(?) m. the moon, L.
N. of the father of Māndhātṛ and of various other men, MBh.; R.; Hariv.; Pur.
युवनाश्व—ज m. ‘son of Y˚’, patr. of Māndhātṛ (an early sovereign of the solar dynasty), L.
N. of a town, Vās., Introd.
